verdict.rationale: Community reports indicate users log into ZCode and use it under the GLM coding plan: free credits after login, a user trying the Pro coding plan in ZCode, a coding-plan usage promotion, and a paying GLM subscriber using it. No first-party documentation describes signing in with an existing subscription, and the plan's base allowance is reportedly undisclosed. Missing for 10: first-party docs on subscription sign-in/account linking, a clear description of which plans entitle agent use, and transparent quota details.
